summary:
Fixed Instagram file compatibility for OneDay Share Your Streak:
1. Native Share pipeline now generates a genuine JPEG image (image/jpeg, quality 0.95, 1200x960 px, filename ending in .jpg) using html-to-image toJpeg.
2. Web Share API invocation shares files only without text/title to maximize Instagram Direct & Stories compatibility.
3. Automatically copies caption (#ShareYourStreak) to clipboard.
4. Maintained separate high-resolution PNG download pipeline.
5. Zero compilation and linting errors.
